args.sql:
SELECT sum(amount) as gross_cents, count(*) as n
FROM memory.bench.orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
